datasets.name: bimanual-cube-new-success

task.description: Bimanual cube grasping success demonstrations collected on or after 2026-07-07, with incomplete wrist-depth episodes removed.

notes: This v2.2 training dataset removes every episode with a wrist-depth stream whose frame count does not equal the episode RGB frame count.
Wrist final keep-masks are generated externally and used only for training-time background augmentation.
